_doc: Thief first-job tracer (#207). Tier C curated ordinary Lv10-70 progression: reqJob bit 8 claws and daggers (including STR daggers), one color per regular armour tier and gender, and Lv22 thief shields; excludes event/Maple/Beginner gifts. Tier A: IDs, reqLevel/reqJob and stats from Character.wz, unchanged. Weapons follow the held family, Thief shields drop only with a dagger (tier C rule in ../equipment_drops.json shield_families, consumed by EquipmentDrops). Late bands (#474, spec #449 C12): extended to reqLevel 120 with every ordinary v83 item of the class in Character.wz (not cash, `only`, `notSale`, `quest`, `timeLimited`, tradeBlock flags, price above 1, named, no GMS item; tier C, GAME_DESIGN 8.3); armour one per slot, reqJob, reqLevel and gender, weapons all; new items from reqLevel 41, plus Warrior and Pirate armour of 35-40 for the step-6 band.
